name: France: Part II package and CTIS upload check
applies_to: the France package as a whole (plan-level checklist step)

items.check: K1 recruitment and informed-consent procedure (FR-K1) on the harmonised template version 2.0, in French, with a section for every population pathway in the plan.
K2 recruitment material (FR-K2) for every participant-facing recruitment item, or a clear statement that no separate advertising is used.
Additional France application document (FR-K-ADDITIONAL), signed and dated by the CTIS applicant.
Main information and consent form (FR-L1) for every participant group.
Separate genetic testing information and consent (FR-L1-GENETIC).
Other participant-facing materials (FR-L2) for every diary, questionnaire, instruction sheet, alert card, digital screen or similar item.
One population-specific information and consent set (FR-L1-POPULATION) per population in population_sets whose trigger is true.
List of sites and principal investigators (FR-M-SITE-LIST) complete and current.
CV (FR-M1) and declaration of interest (FR-M2) for every investigator listed for France, each dated within one year.
Site suitability statement (FR-N1) for every France site, signed by the person responsible for the site.
ARS site authorisation (FR-N-ARS) for each site concerned.
Insurance certificate (FR-O1) issued and dated by an EU insurer covering the France trial period.
Compensation form (FR-P1), stating explicitly when no payment is offered.
CNIL MR-001 receipt or CNIL authorisation (FR-R1) in the data-protection subsection.
Biological-sample compliance form (FR-S1).
No proof of fee submitted: France charges no clinical trial application fee under the current CTIS pathway.
Every participant- or representative-facing document is in French and carries a clear version and date.
Administrative documents are in French; CVs and declarations of interest in French or English.

Signed at submission: Additional France application document (CTIS applicant) and N1 (person responsible for the site); ARS decision and CNIL receipt as official signed documents; all other documents unsigned.
Consent forms include signature fields even though unsigned versions are filed.
Every France site and investigator matches across CTIS, the protocol, insurance and suitability documents.
CV and declaration-of-interest dates checked against the France recency rules (less than one year; GCP training normally within three years).
No contradictory statements across the protocol, recruitment procedure, consent documents, Additional France application document, MR-001 materials and sample template.
Compensation amounts and conditions identical in P1, the Additional France application document and every participant document.
Insurance route in the participant documents consistent with the certificate.
Sample types, storage, transfers and retention identical in S1, the protocol, the laboratory manual and the participant documents.
Data flows, recipients, transfers and retention identical in the participant notices, the MR-001 route and the protocol.
Consent pathways in K1 match the L1 sets in the package.
Documents adapted from the reference package contain all French national additions and no leftovers from the reference country.
items.applies_when: France is not the reference package

items.check: Correct B–S section prefix and CTIS placeholder for each document (biological samples S1; data-protection evidence in the dedicated data-protection subsection).

Unique, self-explanatory title of at most 100 characters: <section code>_<document type>_<subtype>_<country>_<language>_<special attribute>, with only the fields that distinguish the document; _FR_fr on participant-facing documents.
Version and date entered in CTIS metadata, not in the title.
Personal names only where disclosure permits (investigator in M1/M2).
Clean, tracked-change, redacted or public and split-file variants clearly distinguished.
Uploaded filename base contains none of ( ) / , . ; | [ ] (the period before the extension is fine); PDFs contain searchable text.
Article 11 workaround: every mandatory Part II placeholder holds the official placeholder PDF titled Part_II_placeholder_document_Article_11_workaround.
items.applies_when: France receives Part I only under Article 11

items.check: The recruitment procedure template version is the one required on the intended submission date.
For each document, publication status checked against the current Annex I publication tables (revised rules applicable from 18 June 2024; ACT EU guidance v2.2, 30 April 2026).
Publishable documents: personal data and CCI identified separately; public version redacts only qualifying material, irreversibly; signatures never disclosed.
Public and assessment versions differ only by the intended redactions; each in the correct CTIS slot.
No personal data or CCI in public structured fields.
No drafting instruction remains in any document (see content/conventions/template-instructions.md).
Every document approved by the owner in TrialAgents, or the user has explicitly chosen to export unapproved versions.
No participant-facing set is released while a protocol fact, consent giver, optional choice, data transfer, sample purpose, payment or signature block is unresolved.
